title: Who Should Own Your App Store Account? Not Your Developer.
meta_description: Your business should hold the Apple and Google Play developer accounts, not the agency building your app. Apple displays the membership name as your seller name and Google recommends a separate account per client. Verified on Apple and Google documentation.
primary_keyword: who should own the app store developer account
secondary_keywords: can an agency publish my app under their account
